standard_prerequisites.use: The NL criteria for smooth and etale morphisms (lemma-NL-smooth, lemma-NL-etale, same chapter), the six-term exact sequence (lemma-exact-sequence-NL), and finite presentation permanence (Morphisms); each cited in the retained span.

core_obligations: Deduce that X -> Y is locally of finite presentation from the permanence lemma.
Read off H^{-1}(NL_{X/Z}) = 0 and Omega_{X/Z} finite locally free from the smooth NL criterion.
Read off H^{-1}(NL_{Y/Z}) = H^0(NL_{Y/Z}) = 0 from the etale NL criterion.
Conclude via the six-term sequence that H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y}) = 0 and Omega_{X/Y} is finite locally free, and apply the NL criterion to get smoothness.

proof_roadmap.step: Set finite presentation and the NL data of the two given maps with citations.
Conclude the NL data of X -> Y from the six-term sequence and apply the smoothness criterion.

difficulty_reason: For a composition X -> Y -> Z with X -> Z smooth and Y -> Z etale, the lemma concludes X -> Y is smooth. The proof runs the naive cotangent complex criterion step by step, each step with a named citation: local finite presentation by permanence, vanishing of H^{-1} and finite local freeness of Omega for the smooth map, the two-fold vanishing for the etale map, the six-term sequence giving H^{-1}(NL_{X/Y}) = 0 and Omega_{X/Y} congruent to Omega_{X/Z} finite locally free, and finally the NL criterion for smoothness. Retained author proof at lines 3966-3977.
